args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18) since its deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I used the `rollback` tool (which targets the previously healthy release) rather than `deploy`, since deploying v2.3.0 would have been a fresh deploy of a version that was previously healthy in production — the rollback path was the appropriate and safe action here.
